summary: First test iteration for PropShare (Expo RN + FastAPI + Mongo). Backend: 39/39 pytest tests PASSED across auth, properties, wallet, investments, portfolio, marketplace, Razorpay order+signature, admin dashboard/users/approvals/interest, company dashboard, RBAC and suspended-user checks. Frontend: welcome + investor login + home + portfolio + explore + property detail + buy modal + confirm purchase + toast + marketplace + wallet + admin approvals/users/interest + company add-property pages all render and behave correctly on a 390x844 mobile viewport. Role-based routing verified (login.tsx uses router.replace per role, index.tsx also redirects per role). No deprecated Expo packages (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch). No React Native red screens. Only a benign console warning: `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents` (upstream library).

minor.issue: Returns 404 (no health endpoint). Consider adding a lightweight /api/health for uptime probes.
Test data (TEST_prop_*) created by property-create tests remains in DB; add cleanup or an admin bulk-delete for test properties to avoid polluting seeded list.

issues: Leftover TEST_prop_* cards from backend test runs surface on top of seeded 3 properties — not a UI bug but degrades demo experience.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Search app code / dependencies and migrate any `pointerEvents="none"` prop to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` on RN Web 0.20+.

action_items: Optional: add GET /api/health endpoint (returns {status:'ok'}) — currently /api/ returns 404.
Optional: add a cleanup task or admin endpoint to purge TEST_* properties/users created during pytest runs.
Migrate any `pointerEvents` prop usage to style-based to silence RN Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1132 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, properties, wallet, marketplace, admin, company) for maintainability, though not blocking.

buy_shares does not run inside a Mongo transaction; a partial failure could desync wallet vs holdings vs shares_sold. Consider sessions/transactions or compensating logic. Same applies to marketplace/accept.

marketplace accept computes invested decrement using `seller_holding['invested'] / max(seller_holding['shares'], 1)` — division by potentially fractional value works but leaves seller.invested as a residual float; consider zeroing when shares==0.
hosted checkout HTML embeds unsanitised `order_id` (UUID from Razorpay, low risk but XSS surface if ever user-controlled).
Suspend flow: server correctly blocks login of suspended users; token issued before suspension is still valid until expiry (no revocation list). Acceptable for MVP but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: No new persistent seed data. Backend tests create TEST_* investors and 1-2 TEST_prop_* properties per run (they use TEST_ prefix; not cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL from /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py as regression suite. Investor seed wallet is not exactly 500000 anymore because previous test runs debited/credited it. To test admin/company login redirect via the same Playwright session, clear localStorage/AsyncStorage or open a fresh browser context between logins — otherwise the index.tsx redirect uses the cached user and /(auth)/welcome is bypassed. Admin routes verified via direct navigation to /(admin)/approvals, /(admin)/interest, /(admin)/users which all rendered admin tab bar correctly.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no failing tests remain after fixing the insufficient-balance test to use a freshly registered zero-balance investor (session-scoped new_investor fixture was being credited by earlier tests).
